description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Tri-Element Mode II (Fire, Ice, Lightning)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Engineer Mode I (Cater)] and [Machinist Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Engineer Mode I (Cater)
description.text: Machinist abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Machinist abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Machinist abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Machinist abilities

description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Engineer Mode II (Cater)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1

description.name: Dual Awoken Engineer Mode II (Cater)
